title: BIRDNet: Mining and Encoding Boolean Implication Knowledge Graphs as Interpretable Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.28739v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tabular data in knowledge-rich domains often carries a latent prior in the form of Boolean implication relationships (BIRs) between pairs of features. We mine such relationships with a sparse-exception binomial test. We encode the resulting typed graph as the connectivity of a layered neural network, called BIRDNet, in which each hidden unit corresponds to one mined rule and binds only to its two features. We show two consequences of this design: First, the architecture is sparse: at most $2/d$ of the weights in each BIR layer are active, where $d$ is the input dimension. Second, the model is intrinsically interpretable: every trained unit keeps a stable symbolic identity, so rules can be read off the network without surrogate models. Unlike most neurosymbolic models, BIRDNet does not consume an external rule base; its structural prior is mined from the data. We evaluate BIRDNet on six transcriptomic and proteomic benchmarks. O

translated_title: BIRDNet：挖掘和编码布尔蕴含知识图谱为可解释的深度神经网络
translated_abstract: 摘要：知识丰富领域中的表格数据通常以特征对之间的布尔蕴含关系（BIRs）形式携带潜在先验。我们使用一种稀疏异常二项检验来挖掘此类关系。我们将得到的类型化图编码为分层神经网络的连接结构，称为BIRDNet，其中每个隐藏单元对应一条挖掘出的规则，并仅绑定到其两个特征。我们展示了这种设计的两个结果：第一，架构是稀疏的：每个BIR层中最多有$2/d$的权重是活跃的，其中$d$是输入维度。第二，模型本质上是可解释的：每个训练单元保持稳定的符号身份，因此无需替代模型即可直接从网络中读取规则。与大多数神经符号模型不同，BIRDNet不消耗外部规则库；其结构先验是从数据中挖掘的。我们在六个转录组学和蛋白质组学基准上评估了BIRDNet。
tldr: BIRDNet通过从数据中挖掘布尔蕴含关系并编码为稀疏、可解释的神经网络，实现了无需外部规则库的神经符号学习。
en_tdlr: BIRDNet mines Boolean implication relationships from data and encodes them into a sparse, interpretable neural network, enabling neurosymbolic learning without an external rule base.
